Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC. Configures DSI host for DBI mode with 4 data lanes, enables DMAC interrupts, initializes PHY, configures DBI parameters, loads random data and write commands into SRAM, triggers DMAC transfers on CH0 (data) and CH1 (command), and verifies completion via interrupt handling.
Pre-Conditions: System reset complete; DSI host powered; D-PHY ready; SRAM accessible
Test Steps: Step 1: Enable GIC IRQ for DSI interrupt
Pass/Fail Criteria: GIC IRQ enabled for DSI_INTR_NO
Notes: Interrupt infrastructure setup

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 2: Write 0x3 to DMAC_INTEN to enable interrupts for CH0 and CH1
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC interrupts for both channels enabled
Notes: Enables DMAC channel 0 and channel 1 interrupts

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 3: Write GDMA_INTR bit to INTERRUPT_ENABLE register to enable GDMA interrupt at subsystem level
Pass/Fail Criteria: GDMA interrupt enabled at subsystem level
Notes: Subsystem-level interrupt enable for GDMA

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 4: Configure PHY_IF_CFG with n_lanes=3 and phy_stop_wait_time=0x40
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY configured for 4 data lanes with stop wait time 0x40
Notes: n_lanes=3 means 4 lanes; phy_stop_wait_time field at bits[15:8]

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 5: Write 0x3D to PCKHDL_CFG register
Field Name: eotp_tx_en, eotp_rx_en, bta_en, ecc_rx_en, crc_rx_en, eotp_tx_lp_en
Pass/Fail Criteria: Packet handling configured: EoTp TX/RX, BTA, ECC RX, CRC RX enabled
Notes: 0x3D = 0b00111101: eotp_tx_en=1, eotp_rx_en=0, bta_en=1, ecc_rx_en=1, crc_rx_en=1, eotp_tx_lp_en=1

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 6: Write 0x107 to CLKMGR_CFG register
Pass/Fail Criteria: Clock manager configured: TX escape clk div=7, timeout clk div=1
Notes: tx_esc_clk_division=0x07, to_clk_division=0x01

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 7: Write 0x0 to DPI_CONTROL to select DBI mode
Pass/Fail Criteria: DBI mode selected (DPI disabled)
Notes: dbi_dpi_en=0 selects DBI mode

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 8: Initialize PHY (phy_init function call)
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY initialization sequence completed successfully
Notes: Calls phy_init() which configures PHY_RSTZ and related registers

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 9: Configure DBI parameters - VCID=3, LUT_SIZE=1, OUT_DBI=0xB, IN_DBI=0x0, partitioning_en=1, wr_cmd_size based on 40 pixels, tear_fx_en=1
Pass/Fail Criteria: DBI configuration applied: vcid=3, lut_size=1, out_dbi=0xB, partitioning enabled, tear effect enabled
Notes: dbi_config() function configures all DBI-related registers

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 10: Setup DMAC descriptors for CH0 (data) and CH1 (command) with source/destination addresses and lengths
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC descriptors programmed in SRAM
Notes: CH0 data at RAM_BASE+0x10000; CH1 cmd at RAM_BASE+0x0000; Descriptors at RAM_BASE+0x3F000/0x3F800

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 11: Load random data into SRAM for data channel and write command (DSI_WRITE_MEMORY_START) for command channel
Pass/Fail Criteria: Random payload data and DCS write_memory_start command loaded into SRAM
Notes: load_rand_data() and load_wr_command() with DSI_WRITE_MEMORY_START

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 12: Trigger DMAC CH0 transfer via DBGINST0=0x00A00000, DBGINST1=ch0_desc_addr, DBGCMD=0x0
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC CH0 transfer initiated
Notes: DBGINST0[23:16]=0xA0 selects DMAGO for CH0

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 13: Trigger DMAC CH1 transfer via DBGINST0=0x01A00000, DBGINST1=ch1_desc_addr, DBGCMD=0x0
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC CH1 transfer initiated
Notes: DBGINST0[23:16]=0xA0 with bit[24]=1 selects DMAGO for CH1

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 14: Wait for both CH0 and CH1 interrupts (int_pend1 becomes 0). ISR reads INTERRUPT_MASK, verifies GDMA_INTR, reads DMAC_INTMIS, clears via DMAC_INTCLR, clears subsystem via INTERRUPT_RAW
Field Name: gdma_intr / channel status / clear / raw status
Pass/Fail Criteria: Both DMAC channels complete transfer and interrupts are properly serviced
Notes: ISR verifies interrupt source and clears at both DMAC and subsystem levels

Test Description: Basic DBI write memory test with DMAC.
Test Steps: Step 15: Verify test completion with err0=0 (no unexpected interrupts)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Test PASS if err0==0; FAIL if err0>0
Notes: finish(err0) called - 0 means pass

Test Description: DBI random payload size test. Iterates 10 times with random pixel counts (multiples of 8 up to 8192), reconfigures DBI for each iteration, performs DMAC-based DBI write memory transfers, and verifies completion by polling DMAC interrupt status.
Pre-Conditions: System reset complete; DSI host powered; D-PHY ready; SRAM accessible
Test Steps: Step 1: Configure PHY_IF_CFG with n_lanes=3 and phy_stop_wait_time=0x40
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY configured for 4 data lanes
Notes: Same PHY config as basic test

Test Steps: Step 2: Write 0x3D to PCKHDL_CFG register
Pass/Fail Criteria: Packet handling configured
Notes: Same as basic test

Test Steps: Step 3: Write 0x107 to CLKMGR_CFG register
Pass/Fail Criteria: Clock manager configured
Notes: tx_esc_clk_division=7, to_clk_division=1

Test Steps: Step 4: Write 0x0 to DPI_CONTROL to select DBI mode
Pass/Fail Criteria: DBI mode selected
Notes: DPI disabled

Test Steps: Step 5: Initialize PHY
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY initialization completed
Notes: phy_init() call

Test Steps: Step 6: Configure DBI - VCID=3, LUT_SIZE=1, OUT_DBI=0xB, IN_DBI=0x0, partitioning_en=0, allowed_cmd_size=0x25, tear_fx_en=1
Pass/Fail Criteria: DBI configured with partitioning disabled and allowed_cmd_size=0x25
Notes: partitioning_en=0 means auto-partitioning by HW; allowed_cmd_size=0x25

Test Steps: Step 7: Write 0x3 to DMAC_INTEN to enable CH0 and CH1 interrupts
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC interrupts enabled for both channels
Notes: Interrupt enable for polling-based completion check

Test Steps: Step 8: Loop 10 iterations - each iteration: generate random pixel count (rand()%1024)*8, compute wr_cmd_size and num_bytes, reconfigure DBI via dbi_config()
Pass/Fail Criteria: DBI reconfigured with new random payload size each iteration
Notes: Pixel count varies: (rand()%1024)*8; pixel_to_bytes_wr_cmd_size() computes sizes

Test Steps: Step 9: Per iteration - Setup DMAC descriptors, load random data and write command, trigger CH0 and CH1 DMAC transfers
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMAC transfers triggered for both channels
Notes: Same DMAC trigger mechanism as basic test

Test Steps: Step 10: Per iteration - Poll DMAC_INTMIS until value equals 0x3 (both channels done), then write 0x3 to DMAC_INTCLR to clear
Pass/Fail Criteria: Both DMAC channels complete and interrupts cleared
Notes: Polling-based completion (no ISR used in this test)

Test Steps: Step 11: Verify all 10 iterations completed successfully with finish(0)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Test PASS if all 10 random payload iterations complete without error
Notes: finish(0) indicates success

Test Description: Register write/read verification test for MIPI DSI subsystem registers. Tests 5 registers (DATA_FIFO_THRESHOLD_VAL, LOW_PWR, DBITE, DBI_FDIV, INTERRUPT_RAW) for default value correctness and write/read integrity using 6 data patterns.
Pre-Conditions: System reset complete; All registers at default reset values
Test Steps: Step 1: Default Value Check (chk_rst_val) - Read each register and compare against expected default values
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read value matches default reset value
Notes: Default: upper_thrsh_val=0x7D0, lower_thrsh_val=0x10

Test Steps: Step 2: Default Value Check - Read LOW_PWR register
Field Name: dbipld_mem_slp, dbipld_mem_sd, dbiread_mem_slp, dbiread_mem_sd, genericpld_mem_slp, genericpld_mem_sd, genericread_mem_slp, genericread_mem_sd, slp_cmnd_mem, sd_cmnd_mem, slp_data_mem, sd_data_mem, slp_wrdata_mem, sd_wrdata_mem, dpipixel_mem_slp, dpipixel_mem_sd, slp_data_dmac, sd_data_dmac, slp_pt_dmac, sd_pt_dmac
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read value matches default (all zeros)
Notes: All power control bits default to 0

Test Steps: Step 3: Default Value Check - Read DBITE register
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read value matches default (0)
Notes: Read-only status register; default=0

Test Steps: Step 4: Default Value Check - Read DBI_FDIV register
Expected Value: Default: sel_1_i=2, sel_2_i=0, reg_reprogram_i=0, clk_en_i=1, ovrd_i=0 => 0x00000802
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read value matches default reset value
Notes: clk_en_i defaults to 1 (bit 11), sel_1_i defaults to 2

Test Steps: Step 5: Default Value Check - Read INTERRUPT_RAW register (skipped if read_mask=0)
Field Name: dsi_intr, gdma_intr, fifo_full_cmnd, fifo_empty_cmnd, fifo_full_data, fifo_empty_data, fifo_full_pixdata, fifo_empty_pixdata, and more
Expected Value: Default with FIFO empty bits set
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read value matches default reset value
Notes: Some FIFO empty status bits default to 1

Test Steps: Step 6: Write/Read Check - Pattern 1: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to all writable registers, read back and verify against (write_data & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_value)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: INTERRUPT_RAW skipped (skip_array=1); DBITE skipped (write_mask=0)

Test Steps: Step 7: Write/Read Check - Pattern 2: Write 0xAAAAAAAA to all writable registers, read back and verify
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: Alternating bit pattern test

Test Steps: Step 8: Write/Read Check - Pattern 3: Write 0x55555555 to all writable registers, read back and verify
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: Complementary alternating bit pattern

Test Steps: Step 9: Write/Read Check - Pattern 4: Write 0x00000000 to all writable registers, read back and verify
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: All zeros pattern

Test Steps: Step 10: Write/Read Check - Pattern 5: Write 0xA5A5A5A5 to all writable registers, read back and verify
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: Walking ones/zeros pattern

Test Steps: Step 11: Write/Read Check - Pattern 6: Write 0xFFFF0000 to all writable registers, read back and verify
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read-back matches expected value considering masks
Notes: Upper half ones / lower half zeros pattern

Test Steps: Step 12: Final verification - Check def_fail_cnt and wr_fail_cnt are both 0
Pass/Fail Criteria: Test PASS if both fail counters are 0; FAIL otherwise
Notes: finish(1) if any failures; finish(0) if all pass
